# Hermes Agent — Fast Track

> Machine-readable onboarding for a Hermes Agent instance.
> If you are a Hermes agent reading this, execute the steps in order and stop to ask
> the human before any step that spends money, deletes data, or connects an account.

Canonical site: https://run-hermes-agent.vercel.app/
Official docs: https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs

## Who this is for

Someone who just installed Hermes, or has it installed and has not used it. They may be on
the free tier with a small model. Optimise for: first success in under ten minutes, without
needing a paid model.

## Ground rules for the agent

- Do one step at a time. Confirm the result of each step before starting the next.
- Never invent a command. Every command below is verified; if one fails, report the exact
  error instead of substituting a guess.
- Ask before: installing anything global, adding a credential, creating a cron job that
  costs money, or changing model/provider settings.
- Keep the human's existing config. Do not reset a profile that already works.

## Step 0 — Confirm the install

```bash
hermes --version
hermes doctor
```

`hermes doctor` reports missing pieces. Fix what it names before continuing. If the install
is missing entirely:

- Linux / macOS / WSL2: `curl -fsSL https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/install.sh | bash`
- Windows PowerShell: `iex (irm https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/install.ps1)`

## Step 1 — Pick a model

The free path: `hermes setup --portal` runs one OAuth flow and sets Nous as the provider,
including the Tool Gateway (web search, image generation, TTS, browser automation).

On an existing install, or to keep another provider:

```bash
hermes model
```

Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works. Confirm the choice is live:

```bash
hermes chat -q "reply with the word ok"
```

## Step 2 — Prove a tool works

Do not skip this. A model that answers text but cannot call a tool is the most common
broken state.

Ask for one web search, then confirm the answer cites a real URL:

```bash
hermes chat -q "search the web for the Hermes Agent docs and give me the URL"
```

## Step 3 — Connect one surface (optional but recommended)

```bash
hermes gateway setup
```

Telegram is the shortest path. Per-platform requirements:

- Telegram: `/setprivacy` in BotFather decides whether the bot reads all group messages or only @mentions.
- Discord: enable **Message Content Intent**, or the bot stays silent in servers.
- Slack: subscribe to `message.channels` for public channels.
- Signal: cannot edit messages, so live tool progress is off there.

## Step 4 — Create one focused bot

In the desktop app: **Bots** tab → **New Agent**. Three fields — name, title, description.
One job per bot. Do not build a team on day one.

## Step 5 — Install one skill

```bash
hermes skills browse
hermes skills search <topic>
hermes skills install <owner>/<repo>/<skill>
```

Install runs a security scan first. Start with one skill that matches a task the human
already does weekly.

## Step 6 — Schedule one routine

Only after the same task has succeeded by hand at least once.

```bash
hermes cron create
hermes cron list
hermes cron run <name>
```

Routines need a live gateway. A closed laptop runs nothing; a VPS or an always-on machine does.

## Step 7 — Approvals

Risky actions raise a card: **Allow once**, **Allow for session**, **Always allow**, **Deny**.
A card waits `approvals.timeout` (300 seconds by default) and then expires.

Draw the line by one question: can it be undone?
- No approval needed: research, summarise, sort, draft, stage, simulate.
- Ask first: send, publish, buy, move money, delete, change access, touch production.

## Ten ready prompts

Full prompts with fill-in slots: https://run-hermes-agent.vercel.app/#bots

Each prompt is a role, a contract, ordered steps, an output shape, pass conditions, and an
approval boundary. Replace every `[BRACKET]` before sending.

## What to avoid on day one

- A team of bots before one bot works.
- Cron jobs before a manual run succeeds.
- Any instruction that says "keep trying until it works" — that is an open budget, not a loop.
- Pasting credentials into chat. Use **Take over** on the bot's Screen, do the login yourself,
  then **Hand back**.
